tests.title: Smart Bone switch for a native gap fill (left shoulder raised)
tests.why: Smart Bone actions and Switch layers have no Lua evidence; the hybrid rig needs them for the gap fills.
steps: Open the saved Phase 4.2 document (after the build and the save).
In the bone layer AutoRig_P42_Hybrid, add a Switch layer named after the asset (e.g. native_gap_shoulder_l__left_arm_raised) and drag it to the bottom of the bone layer's children.
Inside the Switch layer, add an empty layer named 'off', then import each key PNG from correctives/<asset>/ (File > Import > Image) and name each image layer after its key (k025 ... k100).
Bind the Switch layer to the bone named in smartbone_plan.json (attach_bone) with the Bind Layer tool.
Select the driver bone (e.g. LEFT_UPPER_ARM) and create a Smart Bone action for it in the Actions window (Moho names a Smart Bone action after its bone).
In the action, key the Switch layer at 'off' for the rest angle, then rotate the driver bone to each key's offset (smartbone_plan.json keys[].bone_offset_deg) and key the Switch layer to that key.
Leave the action, scrub the driver bone between rest and the raised pose: record whether the fill appears under the armpit, switches without popping, and disappears at rest.
Save, close, reopen, run the Phase 4.2 verify script (it lists the actions it finds) and render frame 20.
tests.record: observations.json: smart_bone.MT-1 = {works: true|false, notes, screenshot names}

tests.title: Same Smart Bone switch for the other assets
tests.why: every native_gap_* asset listed in smartbone_plan.json needs the same manual set-up
steps: Repeat MT-1 for each asset in smartbone_plan.json whose native_automation is manual_switch.

tests.title: Flexible binding of the torso image layer (discovery)
tests.why: a torso lean tears a rigidly bound blazer at the waist; Moho's saved files carry a per-layer flexi_bone_subset key (observed in Phase 4.0), but setting it from Lua is not evidenced
steps: In a copy of the saved document, select the torso image layer and try binding it to SPINE_LOWER, SPINE_UPPER and CHEST together (flexible binding / Bind Points or the layer's bone settings, whichever Moho 14.5 offers for image layers).
Go to frame 80 (torso lean after the verify script) and render it.
Save the copy; keep it for the file-format diff (autorig moho-file diff).
tests.record: observations.json: flexi.MT-3 = {possible: true|false, how, render, saved_file}

tests.title: Visual review of the native renders by a person
tests.why: numbers never approve articulation; the person decides whether the joints read as natural
steps: Open comparisons/ (written by native-hybrid-verify) and the Moho renders of frames 1-90.
Judge shoulders, elbows, hips, knees and the torso: outlines, garment silhouettes, attachment, proportions, overlaps, distortion.
